source_evidence: Exact player 'We have men near the customs tower. We will also be clearing a way up to around 20 miles from here (near the supposed ancestral seat)' informs the scouts of V's people near the existing western customs tower and intended route clearance approximately20 miles farther from present encounter. H1 recognizes the tower as a practical proposed rendezvous, says a messenger could approach it to arrange discussions, and notes a usable cleared upland route would interest the company. H1 asks whose name to give and whom to approach there, and offers to keep the proposed arrangements separate from any actual passage permission. H2 marks the approximate proposed future corridor, not an exact location of the seat or verified surveyed road. This is prospective discussion only: no actual clearance, site disclosure beyond player's approximate distance, new route survey, title, permission to traverse, payment, contract, meeting date, dispatch or captain's assent. V's statement of intent does not authorize spending on roadworks or diverting his existing men. No roll, new combat, movement or expenditure. V next reply.
